The finite causal-identification example has passive ceiling 50% and intervention 8191/8192 with <=12 queries; an unrestricted conventional optimal planner matches it.

foundations.title: Invent the Economy: Transformational Intelligence for Creating Viable Markets
foundations.finding: Joint technical construction and voluntary commercial arrangement can create feasibility. Separate correctness, participant benefit, profitability, liquidity and realized exchange. Four fictional buyers with shared core yield expected contribution $120,000 at assumed qualification p=0.8; successful path $300,000; prefunding $900,000; $40,000 delivery burden reverses expected gain; 2240 exact parameter cases.
